"""Camera-guided controller for VLABench take_out_cool_drink (instance i00).

Only the eai-standard Robot client is used. The script stores the motion helpers
and empirical TCP Jacobian used for safe, short joint-position movements.
"""
import json, sys, time
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver

DT = 0.1
LAYOUT = ["joint1_pos", "joint2_pos", "joint3_pos", "joint4_pos", "joint5_pos", "joint6_pos", "joint7_pos"]

class Controller:
    def __init__(self):
        self.robot = Robot()
        self.spec = self.robot.spec()

    def obs(self, cameras=("left", "right"), depth=False):
        return self.robot.get_obs(cameras=list(cameras), include_depth=depth, video="none")

    def q_pose(self):
        p = self.robot.status().get("proprio")
        if p is not None:
            x = dict(zip(p["layout"], p["now"]))
            return np.array([x[f"joint{i}_pos"] for i in range(1, 8)]), np.array([x["tcp_x"], x["tcp_y"], x["tcp_z"]]), np.array([x[f"tcp_q{v}"] for v in ("w", "x", "y", "z")])
        o = self.obs(cameras=())
        p = o.meta["proprio"]
        x = dict(zip(p["layout"], p["now"]))
        return np.array([x[f"joint{i}_pos"] for i in range(1, 8)]), np.array([x["tcp_x"], x["tcp_y"], x["tcp_z"]]), np.array([x[f"tcp_q{v}"] for v in ("w", "x", "y", "z")])

    def move(self, goal, seconds=1.0, fingers=0.04, note="guided move"):
        q0, _, _ = self.q_pose()
        goal = np.asarray(goal, dtype=float)
        n = max(1, int(round(seconds / DT)))
        path = np.column_stack((np.linspace(q0, goal, n), np.full((n, 2), fingers)))
        res = self.robot.submit("joint_position", path, dt=DT, interpolate="linear", cameras=None, video="none", note=note)
        return res

    def observe_state(self):
        q, p, quat = self.q_pose()
        return {"q": q.tolist(), "tcp_xyz": p.tolist(), "tcp_qwxyz": quat.tolist(), "status": self.robot.status()}

def probe():
    c=Controller()
    q0,p0,r0=c.q_pose()
    print("start",json.dumps({"q":q0.tolist(),"tcp":p0.tolist(),"status":c.robot.status()}))
    rows=[]
    for i in range(7):
        q_before,p_before,r_before=c.q_pose()
        goal=q_before.copy(); goal[i]+=0.025
        c.move(goal,seconds=0.6,note=f"TCP Jacobian probe joint {i+1}")
        q_after,p_after,r_after=c.q_pose()
        dq=q_after-q_before
        rows.append({"joint":i+1,"dq":dq.tolist(),"dp":(p_after-p_before).tolist(),"tcp":p_after.tolist(),"q":q_after.tolist()})
        c.move(q_before,seconds=0.6,note=f"return from TCP Jacobian probe joint {i+1}")
        print("probe",json.dumps(rows[-1]))
        if c.robot.status().get("done"):
            break
    print("end",json.dumps(c.observe_state()))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    mode=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else "status"
    c=Controller()
    if mode=="probe":
        # Controller already connected, use shared instance for probe.
        q0,p0,r0=c.q_pose()
        print("start",json.dumps({"q":q0.tolist(),"tcp":p0.tolist(),"status":c.robot.status()}))
        for i in range(7):
            qb,pb,rb=c.q_pose(); goal=qb.copy(); goal[i]+=0.025
            c.move(goal,seconds=0.6,note=f"TCP Jacobian probe joint {i+1}")
            qa,pa,ra=c.q_pose()
            print("probe",json.dumps({"joint":i+1,"dq":(qa-qb).tolist(),"dp":(pa-pb).tolist(),"tcp":pa.tolist(),"q":qa.tolist()}))
            c.move(qb,seconds=0.6,note=f"return from TCP Jacobian probe joint {i+1}")
            if c.robot.status().get("done"): break
        print("end",json.dumps(c.observe_state()))
    elif mode=="status":
        print(json.dumps({"spec":c.spec,"status":c.robot.status(),"state":c.observe_state()},indent=2))
